findings.title: Tooltip guard may miss widgets or rely on stale properties
findings.message: The guard walks parent chain per hover event and only checks the property on the scroll frame. Because the property is set on a frame via SetProperty, a stale property could remain if the scroll frame is replaced/disposed while capture is active; the DeleteProperty in end() only runs if g.scroll still holds g. Also, the guard is bound only in mountControl, so controls mounted elsewhere (e.g. chrome frames, non-control widgets such as row containers) do not suppress tooltips.
findings.suggestion: Verify all row widgets are mounted via mountControl, or store the active-drag state on a shared scene-level object instead of walking the parent chain; add a test for tooltips on non-control row children.
